content: Flux LoRA VRAM guidance from sd-scripts docs: 24GB=batch2 basic; 16GB=batch size 1 + blocks_to_swap=8; 12GB=blocks_to_swap=16 + AdamW8bit; 10GB=blocks_to_swap=22 + fp8 T5. Memory flags: --fp8_base (PyTorch>=2.1), --blocks_to_swap=N (max 35), --cpu_offload_checkpointing, --cache_latents(+_to_disk), --cache_text_encoder_outputs(+_to_disk), --gradient_checkpointing, --sdpa. T4 caveat: Turing lacks native bf16; fp16 causes NaN loss on Flux; workaround = mixed_precision bf16 + fp8_base (emulated, slow) per sd-scripts issue #1595. A100 (Ampere) has native bf16.
